{{Quote|This reminds me of a cave I found on Corrida. Almost died there. Great, now I'm having flashbacks.|[[Vette]]|<ref name="TOR:BL">{{TORcite|type=location|Bloodgouge's Lair|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Bloodgouge's Lair''' was a cave located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the cave was inhabitable by a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] tribe.<ref name="TOR:BaS" /> After the sandpeople attacked [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] at the nearby [[Outpost Rennar]], an Imperial strike force raided the cave and killed most of the tribe,<ref name="TOR:BaS" /> while the Tusken [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Bloodgouge]] himself was killed by Republic operatives around the same time.<ref name="TOR:AJC">{{TORcite|type=heroic|A Jawa's Concern|Tatooine}}</ref>
